items.desc_now: A curated collection of awesome plugins for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — task notifications, LLM trace inspection, keybindings with a built-in terminal, and local agent delegation.

Proactive follow-ups for DeepSeek Harness: the model schedules host-level alarms (once/every/cron with jitter, quiet hours, daily budget) that resume cold sessions, with tombstone compaction and a live web panel.
